title: BYD Emerges as Frontrunner in Solid-State Battery Race, First EV Slated for 2027
detail: BYD is now considered the leading contender in the global solid-state battery commercialisation race, with its first electric vehicle using solid-state technology expected to launch in 2027. The Chinese EV and battery giant is outpacing rivals Toyota and Samsung on commercialisation timelines, signalling a potential shift in the competitive landscape for next-generation battery technology.
